criteria.name: Audio-only and Video-only (Prerecorded)
criteria.note: Media content. Theya has no media player.

criteria.name: Captions (Prerecorded)
criteria.note: Media content.

criteria.name: Audio Description or Media Alternative (Prerecorded)
criteria.note: Media content.

criteria.name: Captions (Live)
criteria.note: Media content.

criteria.name: Audio Description (Prerecorded)
criteria.note: Media content.

criteria.name: Sensory Characteristics
criteria.note: Instructions written by the app ("the button on the right"). Theya's own strings were written without shape/position cues.

criteria.name: Orientation
criteria.note: No component locks orientation: no orientation media queries hide content, and every story passes at 360px.

criteria.name: Audio Control
criteria.note: Theya plays no audio.

criteria.name: Images of Text
criteria.note: Images are the app's content. Theya renders text as text.

criteria.name: Three Flashes or Below Threshold
criteria.note: No component flashes: the fastest loop is the 700 ms spinner, and nothing alternates bright/dark.

criteria.name: Bypass Blocks
criteria.note: A page property. The WorkspaceLayout block ships a skip link the app can reuse.

criteria.name: Page Titled
criteria.note: The app sets document titles.

criteria.name: Multiple Ways
criteria.note: Site navigation and search — the app's information architecture.

criteria.name: Pointer Cancellation
criteria.note: Actions fire on click (pointer up), not pointer down; press-and-hold controls cancel when the pointer leaves.

criteria.name: Motion Actuation
criteria.note: No component reacts to device motion.

criteria.name: Language of Page
criteria.note: The app sets <html lang>.

criteria.name: Language of Parts
criteria.note: Content language. Theya's built-in strings follow the active locale.

criteria.name: Consistent Navigation
criteria.note: Across pages.

criteria.name: Consistent Identification
criteria.note: Across pages. Shared components and locale strings make it the default.

criteria.name: Consistent Help
criteria.note: Across pages.

criteria.name: Error Suggestion
criteria.note: The message text is the app's. Theya provides the slot (error / helper text) and announces it.

criteria.name: Error Prevention (Legal, Financial, Data)
criteria.note: A flow property. ConfirmDialog and UndoToast are the tools.

criteria.name: Redundant Entry
criteria.note: A flow property.
